_doc: What the stranger's told when he's lost, in plain words (and, next, the first-time hints). 'death': the end screen's tip under how he died (game.why_dead). A rule matches when every key it has fits: 'how' (shot, finished, bled, blast, own_blast, own_mines), 'guns' (the killer's gun kinds, Weapon.DATA), 'range' (close, long), 'many' (true: three or more firing on him at the end). The rule matching the most keys wins; the first such one on a tie. The last, with no keys, is for anything else.

death.tip: Too many at once. Break their line of sight and let them come to you one at a time.
Don't let a shotgun get close. Drop him on the way in.
Rifles reach a long way. Keep walls between you, and cross open ground quickly.
Down, you can still shoot. Make them pay for coming close.
B binds a wound, even while you're down.
A lit stick gives you a few seconds. Get clear of it.
Throw dynamite well away from yourself, and mind the kegs near it.
The charges go up all round the breastwork. Stay behind the bags when you fire them.
Stay out of their sight and crouch behind cover.
